# Chapter 44 – Regional Mars

Scene 1. The colony processes the Site Beta results.

Scene 2. Arun admits that expansion is now technically justified.

Scene 3. Imani admits the cost was worse than she expected.

Scene 4. Elena sees the next stage clearly: they are no longer only defending one habitat. They are learning to occupy a landscape.

Scene 5. Laila notices a troubling health pattern among EVA-heavy personnel. Bridge: Mars is attacking them slowly now.
